description: Attach a skill to an agent so the agent can use it. Give skill as org:<name> or a bare name for a skill the organization published. The agent always follows the skill's latest version; a version pin such as @v2 is ignored, and the answer says so. An org skill must already exist and be published (create_service with kind skill, then publish_skill), except a built-in such as governance or security: when the organization has published no skill of that name, the agent holds Valet's default, follows it, and moves to the organization's own skill once one is published. Give catalog:<name> for a skill from Valet's curated catalog: it installs a copy into the organization, or reuses the copy installed before, and attaches it at its latest version. A catalog skill whose name the organization's own skill holds is refused. The agent is rebuilt so the change takes effect. A skill that is already attached answers that nothing changed, without a rebuild; one whose name another attached skill holds is refused with nothing changed. Skills attach to agents only. Requires connecting a Valet account.

org_name.description: The Valet organization the agent belongs to. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.

skill.description: org:<name> or a bare name for an organization skill, or catalog:<name> to install and attach a catalog skill. The agent follows the latest version; a @v<N> pin is ignored.

name: attach_skill

already_attached.description: True when attach_skill found the skill already on the agent and changed nothing.

kind.description: Kind of the service the skill attaches to. Always agent: skills attach to agents only.

latest_version.description: The skill's newest version, which the agent follows. Set by attach_skill; absent when the skill has no version, as a default has none.

not_attached.description: True when detach_skill found the skill not attached and changed nothing.

org.description: Name of the Valet organization the call acted in.

pin_ignored.description: True when the skill you gave carried a @v<N> version pin. Pins are retired, so the agent follows the latest version anyway. Set by attach_skill.

skill.description: Name of the skill. attach_skill reports the skill's own name; detach_skill repeats what you passed.

source.description: Set by attach_skill: org for an organization skill, default for a built-in whose Valet default the agent holds because the organization has published no skill of that name. Absent from detach_skill.

title: Attach a skill to an agent
